is: The library's lamp: the light a scene inventory row gives when its row kind glows (score/stages/row_kinds.py, data/checks/row-kinds.json), by how its row is mounted (the row's `anchor`: ceiling, wall, else it stands on something). `high`: where on its piece the light sits, a share of the piece's height; `reach_per_height`: its reach in metres per metre its laid pieces hang above the floor, never under `least_reach`; `strength_per_reach`: its starting strength (a share of the game lamp's energy, tools/usd/scene.LAMP_ENERGY) per metre of reach, which the light sweep then measures against the concept (score/stages/light); `shadows`: whether it casts them. Read by tools/props/scene/lamps.py for every kit's kinds table. Every entry is general: a mount, never a scene's name.
from: 2026-10-21: the medians, per mount, of the 35 lamp rows' hand-typed numbers it replaces (reach over the laid height, strength over reach; the ceiling's shadows were the hub's roof fixture's alone)
